title: NAV Strike Journal (v1)
description: FROZEN v1 contract. One record per NAV strike. Produced by the backend (aggregator component's accumulated keyvalue + on-chain attestation readback) and consumed by the frontend (replay UI, then the identical-shape live-polling API). Do not change field names or types within v1; additive-only changes require a new $id (journal.v2) and a schema_version bump.

schema_version.description: Frozen schema version. Bump only with a new $id.

strike_id.description: Unique id for this NAV strike. Convention: "<service_id>:<trigger.block>". Stable primary key for replay + the live API.

status.description: Lifecycle. pending: strike open, quorum not yet reached. settled: quorum reached and attestation landed on-chain. stalled: quorum unreachable (e.g. not enough honest operators). rejected: the settled result disagreed with an operator that never joined quorum (informational; a sabotage strike is 'settled' with a rejected operator inside operators[]).

service_id.description: Priime service id (hex; hash of the service-manager chain+address). Identifies the vault/strategy's operator set.

vault.description: The vault whose NAV is being attested.

component_digest.description: Content digest of the NAV wasm component every operator ran. With inputs_block, this is the full reproducibility recipe: re-run this exact component at this block and you MUST get result_hash.

block.description: Chain block height at which the strike fired.

tx_hash.description: Originating tx for evm_event triggers; null for cron/block_interval.

inputs_block.description: The block height the NAV was computed against (state pinned here). Determinism anchor: all operators read this block, so honest operators produce identical result_hash.

asset.description: Denomination of every nav value, e.g. "USDC".

decimals.description: Base-unit decimals for every nav value.

nav_unit.description: Unit for all nav / nav_final fields. nav values are integer strings in these base units (no floats, ever).

operators.description: One entry per operator that submitted for this strike. Honest operators share result_hash; a sabotaging operator has a different result_hash and accepted=false.

id.description: Operator signing address (recovered from signature; registered in the on-chain operator registry).

result_hash.description: keccak256 of result_payload. Equality across operators == agreement. THE hash the demo shows.

nav.description: NAV this operator computed, integer string in nav_unit base units.

signature.description: Operator's secp256k1 signature over the Priime envelope (eip191). Readable back from the on-chain attestation's aggregated signature set.

timestamp.description: When this operator's submission was observed (unix seconds, UTC).

accepted.description: True if this submission is part of the quorum-winning set (result_hash == quorum.winning_result_hash).

result_payload.description: Optional. The abi-encoded result bytes that were hashed+signed. Included so anyone can independently recompute keccak256 and decode nav.

threshold.description: Quorum threshold (operator weight; equals operator count in the equal-weight demo, e.g. 2 for 2-of-3).

total.description: Total registered operator weight for the service (e.g. 3).

winning_result_hash.description: The result_hash the quorum formed over; null if quorum never reached.

transitions.description: Ordered fill of the winning group: one entry as each accepted operator arrives, cumulative weight rising to threshold. Drives the 2-of-3 -> 3-of-3 UI animation.

cumulative.description: Running quorum weight after this operator joined.

tx_hash.description: On-chain attestation tx that landed the verified NAV; null until settled. Deep-linked to the block explorer via chain_id.

block_number.description: Block the attestation tx landed in; null until settled.

nav_final.description: Settled NAV (== the winning group's nav), integer string in nav_unit base units; null until settled.
